user.title: Sign in to Garfinho
user.description:
1. Open [the sign-in page]({url}) and sign in with your Garfinho account.
2. Come back here and press **Submit**.

error.login_not_completed: Sign-in was not completed yet. Finish it in the browser, then press Submit again.
